pr_title: tablemetadatacache: write span stats failures to last_update_error
pr_body:
Only the latest commit is for review in this PR.

----------------------------------------

The span stats rpc fan out can contain errors in the
response. Some examples include node dial errors,
or error responses from different nodes. In those cases
we should write the error for the batch to the
last_update_error column and go on to the next batch.

To support reading the errors from the span stats response
we have now split the span stats request off from the query
fetching descriptor information for the batch. Span stats
are now fetched per batch by issuing an rpc request directly
on the span stats server.

Epic: CRDB-37558
Fixes: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/130040

Release note: None

issue_context.title: sql/tablemetadatacache: add batch failure handling logic to update table metadata job
issue_context.body:
Follow up to https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/128993 which updates system.table_metadata in batches. We should add logic to handle cases where a batched metadata collection fails. If a batch fails, we can try in smaller batches or splitting the system.descriptor collection from the span stats RPCs for partial success.

Edit: We'll likely opt for a simpler retry behaviour for the first iteration of this job, which will simply be to retry the query for the failed batch with exponential backoff.

Edit 2: I think retry will be too slow, e.g. if a node is unavailable and there are a lot of batches the job will take a long time to fully complete since it'll retry and fail on every batch. Instead, let's just write the last_error and leave it at that. The entire job can be retried at a later time.


Epic CRDB-37558

Jira issue: CRDB-41848
